check("list(running_total([1, 2, 3])) == [1, 3, 6]", lambda: list(running_total([1, 2, 3])), [1, 3, 6])
check("list(running_total([])) == []", lambda: list(running_total([])), [])


import inspect


def explode_after(values):
    """Yield values, then raise if anyone reads further. Detects code that reads the whole input."""
    yield from values
    raise RuntimeError("read past the values the caller needed")


check("list(running_total([5])) == [5] (single value)", lambda: list(running_total([5])), [5])
check("running_total with negatives and zero", lambda: list(running_total([3, -5, 2, 0])), [3, -2, 0, 0])
check("running_total with floats", lambda: list(running_total([0.5, 0.25])), [0.5, 0.75])
check("running_total accepts an iterator", lambda: list(running_total(iter([1, 2]))), [1, 3])
check("running_total is a generator", lambda: inspect.isgenerator(running_total([1])), True)
check(
    "running_total yields before reading the whole input",
    lambda: next(running_total(explode_after([1, 2]))),
    1,
)
check("running_total of 1..100 ends at 5050", lambda: list(running_total(range(1, 101)))[-1], 5050)

check("list(chunks(range(5), 2))", lambda: list(chunks(range(5), 2)), [[0, 1], [2, 3], [4]])
check("list(chunks([], 3)) == []", lambda: list(chunks([], 3)), [])
check("chunks with size 1", lambda: list(chunks([1, 2, 3], 1)), [[1], [2], [3]])
check("chunks with size above the length", lambda: list(chunks([1, 2], 5)), [[1, 2]])
check("chunks of an exact multiple has no empty tail", lambda: list(chunks(range(4), 2)), [[0, 1], [2, 3]])
check("chunks yields lists", lambda: list(chunks("abc", 2)), [["a", "b"], ["c"]])
check("chunks accepts an iterator (no slicing)", lambda: list(chunks(iter(range(5)), 2)), [[0, 1], [2, 3], [4]])
check("chunks is a generator", lambda: inspect.isgenerator(chunks([1], 1)), True)
check(
    "chunks yields the first batch before reading on",
    lambda: next(chunks(explode_after([1, 2, 3]), 2)),
    [1, 2],
)
check("chunks of 1000 items by 7", lambda: len(list(chunks(range(1000), 7))), 143)

import itertools
check("first_evens(count(1), 3) == [2, 4, 6]", lambda: first_evens(itertools.count(1), 3), [2, 4, 6])
check("first_evens([1, 3], 2) == []", lambda: first_evens([1, 3], 2), [])
check("first_evens(..., 0) == []", lambda: first_evens([2, 4], 0), [])
check("first_evens returns what exists when the stream ends early", lambda: first_evens([1, 2, 3], 5), [2])
check("first_evens keeps zero and negatives", lambda: first_evens([-2, 0, 3], 2), [-2, 0])
check("first_evens keeps duplicates", lambda: first_evens([2, 2, 2], 2), [2, 2])
check(
    "first_evens stops without reading the rest",
    lambda: first_evens(explode_after([1, 2, 3, 4]), 2),
    [2, 4],
)
check(
    "first_evens leaves the next value in the stream",
    lambda: (lambda stream: (first_evens(stream, 2), next(stream))[1])(iter([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6])),
    5,

check("flatten([1, [2, [3]], 4])", lambda: list(flatten([1, [2, [3]], 4])), [1, 2, 3, 4])
check("flatten([]) == []", lambda: list(flatten([])), [])
check("flatten([[[[1]]]]) (deep nesting)", lambda: list(flatten([[[[1]]]])), [1])
check("flatten skips empty sublists", lambda: list(flatten([[], [1, []], []])), [1])
check("flatten does not split strings", lambda: list(flatten(["ab", ["cd"]])), ["ab", "cd"])
check("flatten keeps tuples whole", lambda: list(flatten([(1, 2), [3]])), [(1, 2), 3])
check("flatten keeps None items", lambda: list(flatten([None, [None]])), [None, None])
check("flatten is a generator", lambda: inspect.isgenerator(flatten([1])), True)
check(
    "flatten 200 levels deep",
    lambda: list(flatten(__import__("functools").reduce(lambda inner, _: [inner], range(200), [7]))),
    [7],

check("list(pairwise([1, 2, 3]))", lambda: list(pairwise([1, 2, 3])), [(1, 2), (2, 3)])
check("list(pairwise([1])) == []", lambda: list(pairwise([1])), [])
check("list(pairwise([])) == []", lambda: list(pairwise([])), [])
check("pairwise accepts an iterator", lambda: list(pairwise(iter([1, 2, 3]))), [(1, 2), (2, 3)])
check("pairwise of a string", lambda: list(pairwise("abc")), [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")])
check("pairwise keeps duplicates", lambda: list(pairwise([1, 1])), [(1, 1)])
check(
    "pairwise treats None as a value, not a sentinel",
    lambda: list(pairwise([None, None, 1])),
    [(None, None), (None, 1)],
)
check(
    "pairwise yields before reading the whole input",
    lambda: next(pairwise(explode_after([1, 2, 3]))),
    (1, 2),
)
check("pairwise of 100 items gives 99 pairs", lambda: len(list(pairwise(range(100)))), 99)

check(
    "sum_by_key(...)",
    lambda: sum_by_key([("a", 1), ("a", 2), ("b", 5)]),
    [("a", 3), ("b", 5)],
)
check("sum_by_key([]) == []", lambda: sum_by_key([]), [])
check("sum_by_key with one pair", lambda: sum_by_key([("x", 4)]), [("x", 4)])
check("sum_by_key keeps the last group", lambda: sum_by_key([("a", 1), ("b", 2)]), [("a", 1), ("b", 2)])
check("sum_by_key adds equal pairs", lambda: sum_by_key([("a", 1), ("a", 1)]), [("a", 2)])
check("sum_by_key with negatives", lambda: sum_by_key([("a", -1), ("a", 1)]), [("a", 0)])
check("sum_by_key with int keys", lambda: sum_by_key([(1, 1), (2, 2), (2, 3)]), [(1, 1), (2, 5)])
check("sum_by_key keeps key order", lambda: sum_by_key([("m", 1), ("n", 1), ("o", 1)]), [("m", 1), ("n", 1), ("o", 1)])
check("sum_by_key of 100 pairs for one key", lambda: sum_by_key([("k", 1)] * 100), [("k", 100)])
